TRP channels are the key players for pain and analgesia.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the nociceptive TRPs represent a large family of targets that are amenable to drug discovery and development.
nociceptive TRPs play a central role in the detection and transduction of pain stimuli, and are critical targets for the development of analgesics.

TRP channels are critical targets for pain relief, but the complexity of the mechanisms of TRP activation in different pathological conditions, and the diversity of TRP isoforms and their expression in different pain conditions necessitate a careful and comprehensive understanding of TRP channel function for the development of effective pain relief strategies.
